post.originalText:
One prompt to Claude Opus 5.5 on high: show me what goes on inside an AI data centre.  

35 min later: a 2.5 min 3d film from the grid down to Blackwell silicon. one html file, zero 3d assets.  

Cost me just ~7% of my usage. https://t.co/qRhqyg4Veu
